sections.title: Gunmu Reference Testbed
sections.subtitle: Official reference implementation demonstrating all 0rhxPlayer host APIs, slots, and events.

sections.title: Audio Playback & Transport Control
sections.details: Exposes play(), pause(), resume(), stop(), seek(ms), setVolume(0.0-1.0), and setPlayMode(0-3). Compatible with AudioEngine dispatch.

sections.title: 10-Band Parametric Equalizer & DSP
sections.details: Supports getEqBands(), setEqBand(index, gainDb), getEqPreamp(), setEqPreamp(gainDb), applyEqPreset(presetName), and resetEq() across all 10 audio bands.

sections.title: Media Library & Search Index
sections.details: Enables getLibraryTrackCount(), getAllTracks(limit, offset), getAllAlbums(), getAllArtists(), searchLibrary(keyword), and rescanLibrary().

sections.title: Playlists & User Favorites
sections.details: Allows createPlaylist(name), deletePlaylist(id), renamePlaylist(id, name), addTracksToPlaylist(id, tracks), removeTracksFromPlaylist(id, tracks), and toggleFavorite(trackPath).

sections.title: Synchronized Lyrics Engine
sections.details: Provides loadLrcContent(lrcText), clearLyrics(), hasLyrics(), getLyricCount(), and getLyricLine(index) for runtime LRC stream manipulation.

sections.title: Host Event Bus & Lifecycle Signals
sections.details: Monitors playbackStateChanged, positionChanged, trackChanged, volumeChanged, playModeChanged, eqChanged, queueChanged, libraryChanged, and favoritesChanged.

sections.title: Registered View Slots & Action Injections
sections.details: Entries registered: entries.contextMenu.track (Track Action), entries.contextMenu.album (Album Action), entries.contextMenu.playlist (Playlist Action), and entries.playbackControl (Player Bar Control).

sections.title: Global System Hooks
sections.details: Hooks registered: hooks.search (query interceptor via mock_data/search_results.json) and hooks.lyricsProvider (dynamic external lyric supplier).
